title: The most incriminating evidence against Hans Niemann
summary: Chess master Yosha Iglesias presents an analysis of Hans Niemann's games, highlighting a string of 100% engine-correlation games and comparing them with other players. It was published during the 2022 Niemann-Carlsen cheating scandal.
why: Cited as the source for the claim that Niemann had many 100% engine-match games; one commenter calls it a credible-seeming analysis.
